acceptanceCriteria: The provider row reason names the failing file relative to the repository root, never an absolute path or the user's home directory, and the same repository yields the same reason text on two machines; a test covers a `file:///` error message.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #98 (V1-0099): the reason text 'gopls answered all N queries with an error; first: <error>' copies the JSON-RPC error message as-is, and gopls's message contains the absolute file URI, e.g. `file:///private/tmp/.../healthchecks.go`. A repository under a home folder would put the user's home path into the packet, and the text differs between machines (TCP-V0-045).
title: lspprovider: the `unavailable` reason copies the gopls error verbatim, including an absolute `file://` URI
